description: This file contains shell script functions related to device upgrading and partition management for a specific hardware platform, including functions for checking the platform, performing upgrades, and copying configuration backups.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks the current platform's partition layout against an image and verifies if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the device upgrade process, including partition comparison and image writing.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to a mounted partition.
